title: Tom Clancy's The Division
provenance: Reported by a user (highball-db#180, 2026-09-22): rated 4, playable with minor issues, Apple M5, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.6, DXMT. Not run here.
notes: An online game, and signing in is where the patience goes: the reporter waited five to ten minutes at the server login, after which it played near seamlessly with minor frame rate dips. No frame rate measured. Their Highball was several versions old, so the login wait has not been checked against a current build.

knownIssues.symptom: Signing in to the game's servers takes five to ten minutes
knownIssues.cause: reported on an M5 with macOS 27; not reproduced here, and not yet checked on a current Highball
knownIssues.fix: None known. The reporter's advice is to be patient, after which the game plays well.
